pkgmetadata.longdescription: PageIndex builds a hierarchical tree index of long PDF documents using LLM reasoning instead of vector similarity, enabling retrieval-augmented generation without a vector database. Supports OpenAI, Anthropic and local (litellm) backends, plus an MCP server integration.
